label: Abstract priority: a non-concrete prior item holds and no necessary actual root is a first being
paraphrase: Closed control on one interpretation (one world, two existing candidates, one concrete and one not; the non-concrete one is simply prior to the concrete one; empty selected relation): the non-concrete-priority rival holds; a concrete candidate exists at the world; the whole actual concrete roster is not a borrowing trap; every actual contingent concretum has an actual concrete ground (vacuously: nothing is contingent); excluded middle holds; and no actual root is both necessary and a first being. A statement about this interpretation only.
